abi_review: CFUUIDGetUUIDBytes has a hidden struct result pointer
CFUUIDCreateFromUUIDBytes passes a 16-byte struct by value
CFStorage and _CFRuntime need private ABI evidence
retained_workers: property-list XML parser/serializer and recursive array-copy workers
original public CF calls retained by entry funnels
intentional_bounds: runtime class registration/retrieval is limited to the eight-bit object-header type field and the known table extent
signed allocation and collection byte extents are checked
CFStorage insertion/iteration must make forward progress
short UUID strings return null instead of leaving missing bytes uninitialized
native property-list dictionary recursion is bounded at 512 levels
immutable hash mutations, fixed-capacity overflow and already-parented tree appends produce controlled diagnostics; the original assertion helper at 0x1a994 is a bare return
reference_quirks: CFTreeInsertSibling stores the preceding tree as the sibling parent in the installed 1.4 code
CFTreeSetContext and CFTreeSortChildren are bare-return exports and remain on fallback, outside the 100-entry count
